posts.text:

Project Name: Sample Escrow Demo. Your Role: Personal practice project.

Description: Implemented deposit and withdrawal functions in Solidity.
posts.alt: Resume Builder's Key Projects & Portfolio section shows Sample Escrow Demo, labeled Personal practice project. The example description names Solidity deposit and withdrawal functions and Foundry tests for unauthorized callers and repeat withdrawals.

posts.text:
Example test bullet: Wrote Foundry tests showing unauthorized callers and repeat withdrawals revert.

Two named failure cases answer the site's interview prompt about testing edge cases.
posts.alt: Sample Escrow Demo in the Resume Builder. The example test bullet names two assertions: unauthorized callers revert and repeat withdrawals revert. The entry is labeled Personal practice project.

posts.text:
Example README: run 'forge test'; unauthorized callers revert; a second withdrawal reverts.

Use Link to project/contribution for your repository. The sample leaves it empty.
